changes: Backfilled 11 Koala historical process lessons into .koala/dev-memory/experience.jsonl with sourceStoryId/evidenceRefs, unignored project dev-memory in .gitignore, made search token-aware across source/ref metadata, rendered Source/Refs in dev-memory output, allowed dev_memory_* in default DEV tools, and strengthened the bounded preflight regression test.
usage: Run koala dev_memory_search --query='<topic>' or koala dev_memory_preflight --query='<topic>' before future Koala development; entries are reusable non-authoritative experience hints with source refs, not gate evidence.
expectedOutcome: Querying prior Koala process lessons should return concise experience entries for flow/fact forgery, authority, reviewer, fallback, owner lease, and testing patterns, with non_authoritative source/ref metadata and bounded preflight output.
actualTranscript: Recorded in .koala/story/actives/B-1148/evidence/transcript-diff.md: build passed; dev_memory_search returned 3 source/ref entries; dev_memory_preflight returned 5 entries and about 23 lines; verify-dev-memory passed 61/61; process-fact-contract passed; koala validate reported 15/15 covered.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual matched. The only limitation is intentional: dev-memory remains experience context and does not replace delivery evidence, reviewer passes, CI, or authority receipts.
limitations: none — fully covered for B-1148 scope; dev-memory is deliberately non-authoritative and cannot satisfy gate evidence by design.
pitfalls: A weak bounded-preflight test initially wrote to tmpPreflightDir/experience.jsonl while production reads <root>/.koala/dev-memory/experience.jsonl, so it could pass on an empty result; fixed by using dm.resolveProjectMemoryPath and exact length/sourceStoryId assertions. Koala validate also keeps updating tracked test-evidence.json, which can make session_brief report a stale advisory after validation.
